question: Calculate the total number of wickets taken by each bowler (excluding run-outs and other dismissals not attributed to the bowler), their economy rate (total runs conceded divided by total overs bowled, considering only runs scored off the bat and ignoring any extra runs like wides and no-balls), their strike rate (average number of balls bowled per wicket taken), and their best bowling performance in a single match (the match with the most wickets taken by the bowler, formatted as "wickets-runs" where runs are the runs conceded excluding extras).
sql:
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
        AND wt.kind_out != 'run out'
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_balls AS (
    SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_best_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_in_match,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.bowler ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
        AND wt.kind_out != 'run out'
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.bowler
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.bowler ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    COALESCE(br.runs_conceded, 0) as runs_conceded,
    bb.balls_bowled,
    ROUND(COALESCE(br.runs_conceded, 0) * 6.0 / bb.balls_bowled, 2) as economy_rate,
    ROUND(bb.balls_bowled * 1.0 / bw.wickets_taken, 2) as strike_rate,
    CAST(bbm.wickets_in_match AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(bbm.runs_in_match AS TEXT) as best_bowling
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN bowler_balls bb ON bw.bowler = bb.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_best_match bbm ON bw.bowler = bbm.bowler
ORDER BY bw.wickets_taken DESC
